description: This file defines the 'TestCommand' class, which appears to be a command object used within a larger system related to Eclipse Ditto. The class extends an abstract command and includes methods for handling headers, entity IDs, resource paths, and JSON serialization/deserialization relevant to the command pattern.

classes.name: TestCommand
classes.description: A command class within the Eclipse Ditto framework, used for testing purposes. It extends AbstractCommand and implements methods for handling command payload, headers, entity ID, resource path, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder; currently a no-op in this implementation.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for the command; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new TestCommand instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with this command, currently a default entity ID with an empty string.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path, currently empty.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, currently empty.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a TestCommand instance from a JSON object and headers.
